title: Fall in love with the unsexy plumbing
description: Flashy features won't save a broken infrastructure. Real competitive advantage lives in flawless reconciliation engines, robust core ledger APIs, low token latency, and rock-solid compliance protocols like BI SNAP.

title: AI as an amplifier, not a gimmick
description: Do not ship LLMs for novelty. Run rigorous eval harnesses, establish deterministic fallbacks, protect user funds with strict guardrails, and ensure conversational agents genuinely reduce human friction.

title: Empathy with technical precision
description: Translate cumbersome Bank Indonesia and OJK regulatory mandates into joyful, modular user journeys. Great PMs remove friction without compromising security, risk controls, or architectural elegance.
